episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hae Jo, who runs an errand center, accepts Noh Yang Hee's request to kidnap her on her wedding day. Later, he unexpectedly runs into an old flame.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hae Jo sets out to find his sperm donor, the biological father he never knew. He crashes Jo Jae Mi's wedding and drags her along.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Hae Jo recounts his first meeting with Jae-mi. While a huge fight breaks out at the sundae shop, Eo Heung and Wang Chil Sung's gang close in.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jae Mi makes a tough choice between Hae Jo and her devoted fiancé. Soon they head down to Busan, while a mysterious figure arrives to bail Heung out.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hae Jo spends meaningful time with Ko Jae Geun up in the mountains. Back in Seoul, Chil Sung corners Kkari and forces him to track down his old partner.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Heung reflects on his relationship with Jae Mi. After Hae Jo steals a boat to escape Chil Sung, they end up stranded on a deserted island.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Shaken by the island ordeal, Hae Jo slips into a slump his friend Yang Bong Suk can't lift. Meanwhile, Heung does everything to stay by Jae Mi's side.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Afraid of hurting Jae Mi again, Hae Jo tries to push her away. Later, he takes on a new errand and meets a young girl looking for her long-lost brother.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: After learning about Hae Jo's severe condition, Jae Mi is determined to help him find his biological father. But when she returns, he's gone.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Now alone with Heung, Hae Jo reflects on his unfortunate life. After a tense reunion at Kkari's workplace, Hae Jo decides to confront his painful past.
